content: Vite official docs (vite.dev/guide/env-and-mode) state VITE_* variables are statically replaced at build time and their VALUES end up in the client bundle; 'VITE_* variables should not contain sensitive information such as API keys'. Vite's own security policy (github.com/vitejs/vite/security) frames secret leakage via VITE_ prefix or a misconfigured define as a project-level configuration mistake, not a Vite vulnerability. loadEnv('') returns the merged process.env and inlining it via define leaks CI/CD tokens (vite issue #22561). Variables are inlined at build time, so a static bundle cannot read new host env vars after vite build; changing values requires a rebuild.
